title: Synod Requisition
text:
BY ORDER OF THE WAX SYNOD, in the Abbey's name.

Requisitioned from the Bloomhollow mead cellar: 90 casks mead (to be poured out), 14 stone beeswax (to be burned), 3 cellar-keepers (to be examined for the Drip).

Examined: 3. Found wanting: 3. Sent up to the Works with the next cart.

The cellar is to be sealed with tallow, so that the valley remembers what light is lawful.
